title: NASA-UAP-D022, Gemini 9 Debriefing, 1966
what_is_it: Transcript of a NASA debriefing of astronauts Thomas Stafford and Eugene Cernan following the Gemini IX-A mission.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from the PDF (likely scanned/OCR-poor); all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description only.
Without the actual transcript text, the nature, duration, frequency, and context of the 'flashing lights' and 'sparkles' observations cannot be assessed.
Such phenomena in low Earth orbit may have prosaic explanations (e.g. spacecraft debris, ice particles, retinal effects from cosmic rays) but without the source text no determination can be made.
Single-source document: only the two crew members' accounts are represented.
